record.question: Which country has recently objected the inclusion of kaalapani as part of India?
record.explanation: Answer A: Nepal. Nepal objected to India’s 2019 political map depicting the Kalapani area as Indian territory; Nepal’s foreign-affairs ministry documents the protest and the bilateral dispute. Reference: https://mofa.gov.np/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/Report-on-Nepals-Foreign-Affairs_MOFA_2019-2020.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
